_comment: Committed destination schema for the offline apply-conformance harness (T081, AD054).
It is a data file rather than a Python fixture on purpose: the harness asserts the mutation
the SDK renders, so the schema it renders against has to be a fixed, reviewable input that a
later edit to a test helper cannot quietly reshape.
Four kinds, each carrying one property the harness needs:
ConfSite  - an all-direct human-friendly ID, and a `comment` attribute no payload writes;
ConfTag   - a second all-direct kind, so a peer set has something to point at;
ConfTeam  - an all-direct kind with a cardinality-many relationship, for the replace-set,
PLUS an OPTIONAL CARDINALITY-ONE relationship (`owner`) that no operation in
the harness maps. That second shape is load-bearing (AD088): the destination
library renders `<rel>: null` for exactly this shape on a node it considers
existing, so a flush that re-renders the whole node clears it. Without the
shape in the fixture the harness cannot see that, which is how the defect
reached the tree. Do not remove it;
ConfDevice- a human-friendly ID that CROSSES A RELATIONSHIP, which cannot render keyed
today and is the xfail(strict=True) arm (AD067).
